Why A Reset, Not A Cleanse

Forget everything you know, and fear, about cleanses. The old model asks you to stop eating, white-knuckle through five hungry days, and then go right back to the habits that made you want a reset in the first place.

Kroma was built the other way. The 5-Day Lifestyle Reset is delicious, on-the-go functional nutrition: real food you actually eat, ready in less than a minute, with protein built into every day. You are not subtracting your life for five days. You are rehearsing a better one.

That is why it is called a lifestyle reset. Transform with the Reset, then sustain with Daily Essentials, the lattes, broths, and proteins that keep the rhythm going on ordinary busy days.
